services.name: Dance Classes
services.desc: Join Mary Frances Massey for an upbeat Adult Tap Class and rediscover your rhythm! Combining exercise and creative expression, this class is perfect for movers looking to brush up on their tap steps, rhythms, and short combinations. Tap shoes or hard-soled shoes are recommended. Sessions are held in the Watkins Studio Theater on Tuesdays from 10:00 to 11:00 AM. The cost is $140 for the full 8-week session, or $20 per drop-in class There will be no class on October 13 and November 3. Germantown Performing Arts Center is a 501(c)3 non-profit organization.
